questions.stem: A 45-year-old woman with a history of major depressive disorder is brought to your clinic by her family. They report that despite trying multiple different antidepressants, her depressive symptoms have not improved significantly. They have heard about electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) and are inquiring about its utility and potential side effects. Which of the following statements regarding ECT is incorrect?

options.label: A
options.text: ECT is not utilized as a treatment modality for patients with dysthymic disorder.

options.label: B
options.text: ECT is routinely used in the therapeutic management of complex partial seizures.

options.label: C
options.text: ECT is a therapeutic option for patients suffering from major depressive disorder unresponsive to pharmacologic treatments.

options.label: D
options.text: Memory impairment is a recognized adverse effect associated with ECT.
